title: Transcendence Legacy - Voidswept
description:
In the depths of a forest none dare set foot in, a young man awakens with no memory of his past…

Transcendence Legacy - Voidswept is a fantasy 2D turn-based RPG set in a world ruined by a great catastrophe.

One year prior, a dark cloud of emptiness shrouded the land and gave birth to unknown, malicious creatures. Faced with an unforeseen calamity, the civilization of humanity collapsed in an instant. Then, strange ruins began to appear throughout the land.

Uncover the truth behind a world plagued by monstrosities. Traverse mysterious ruins in search of answers, with dependable allies by your side.

Features• Classic Turn-Based Combat 
Plan each move carefully in a tactical battle system inspired by genre classics

• Party-Based Skill Synergy
Master over 40 abilities and customize your party’s loadout for every encounter. Skills grow stronger and more efficient as you use them.

• Explore a Ravaged World
Discover hidden items, secret passages, and optional bosses throughout mysterious ruins.

• Progression Through Strategy
Equip new gear, level up skills, and unlock powerful character enhancements.

• Story-Rich Journey
Follow an emotionally driven story with optional paths and meaningful character interactions.  Deepen bonds with your allies to unlock unique abilities and learn their backstories.
description_short: Uncover the truth behind a world plagued by monstrosities in a fantasy 2D turn-based JRPG with strategic combat, skill customization, and story-rich exploration.
